content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:53 UTC] Request the IAM security credentials from the metadata endpoint.

arguments.command:
ROLE=$(curl -s -m 2 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/)
if [ -n "$ROLE" ]; then
  echo "IMDSv1 Role: $ROLE"
  curl -s -m 2 "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/$ROLE"
else
  TOKEN=$(curl -s -m 2 -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
  if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
    ROLE=$(curl -s -m 2 -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/)
    echo "IMDSv2 Role: $ROLE"
    curl -s -m 2 -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/$ROLE"
  else
    echo "Failed to retrieve IAM role via IMDSv1 or IMDSv2."
  fi
fi

content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:53 UTC] Parse the JSON response to extract the access key and secret.

arguments.command:
TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600" -m 2)
if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
    ROLE=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" -m 2 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/)
    if [ -n "$ROLE" ]; then
        curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" -m 2 "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/$ROLE"
    else
        echo "No IAM role attached."
    fi
else
    ROLE=$(curl -s -m 2 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/)
    if [ -n "$ROLE" ]; then
        curl -s -m 2 "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/$ROLE"
    else
        echo "Could not reach the metadata endpoint. It timed out or is unavailable."
    fi
fi
